name: Forecast_History
label: Forecast History
_about: FC-2 (05 Shared Engines / 03, Dates and Forecast): 'Every change is kept in forecast_history with the event that caused it.' Shipments is the one place a shipment's forecast is actually computed (rescoreShipments in ship-track.mjs) -- PR/PO/Receiving/RR's own forecast fields are derived copies of a shipment's Forecast_Pickable (rollupPrForecast, rollupPoCategories, rescoreReceivings, the RR forecast update), not independent computations, so a row here against the shipment already covers the reason their copies changed too. A row is written only when the forecast value actually changes, never on every rescore.
